intro: I cook the food I actually want to eat – and make it easy for you too. Welcome to ForFoodSake, my little corner of the internet for easy, flavour-packed recipes from my London kitchen.
story: I’m a London-based home cook who started ForFoodSake in 2017 to share the dishes I was making on busy weeknights – food that’s full of flavour but never fussy. What began as a few videos for friends has grown into a community of food lovers on Instagram and TikTok.

My cooking is shaped by my family’s kitchen, the city I live in and the places I travel to. Today I’m also a resident creator at Good Food. Every recipe here is tested in my own kitchen, so you can cook it with confidence.
I’m so happy you’re here and hope you enjoy following along for the journey ahead.
